Name: Seir
Summary: Seir was a Horite, the father of Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan, and the namesake of Mount Seir.
KeyStory: Seir's children were the dukes of the Horites in the land that Esau would later possess as Edom.
RelatedPeople: Lotan; Shobal; Zibeon; Anah; Dishon, Son of Seir; Ezer; Dishan
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
